mapper.select: SELECT A.CATEGORY_NUM, CONVERT(A.BOARD_NUM, CHAR) AS BOARD_NUM, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(A.TITLE) > 29 THEN CONCAT(SUBSTR(A.TITLE,1,30),"...") ELSE A.TITLE END AS TITLE, CASE WHEN A.CATEGORY_NUM between 200 and 299 THEN (SELECT CONCAT("/summernoteImage/", FILE_PATH, "/", FILE_NAME) FROM BOARD_MEDIAFILE_TEST MT1 WHERE I_BOARD_NUM = CONCAT(LPAD(A.CATEGORY_NUM, 5,'0'), A.BOARD_NUM) AND SEQ = (SELECT MIN(SEQ) FROM BOARD_MEDIAFILE_TEST MT2 WHERE MT1.I_BOARD_NUM = MT2.I_BOARD_NUM AND DELETED = 'N')) ELSE NULL END AS IMGPATH, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BOARD_COMMENT_TEST WHERE I_BOARD_NUM = CONCAT(LPAD(A.CATEGORY_NUM, 5, '0'), A.BOARD_NUM) ) as commentcount, A.EXIST_IMGFILE as existimgfile, A.HOT, A.SQLTEXT FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY_NUM ORDER BY REGISTERED_DATE DESC) AS 'RN', CATEGORY_NUM, BOARD_NUM, TITLE, EXIST_IMGFILE, REGISTERED_DATE, HOT, 'other' as SQLTEXT FROM BOARD_TEST WHERE CATEGORY_NUM IN (303, 401, 200, 201, 202, 203, 204, 205, 206, 500, 501, 502, 503) UNION ALL SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY B.CATEGORY_NUM ORDER BY B.HOTREG_DATE DESC) AS 'RN', A.CATEGORY_NUM, A.BOARD_NUM, A.TITLE, A.EXIST_IMGFILE, A.REGISTERED_DATE, A.HOT, 'hot' as SQLTEXT FROM BOARD_TEST A, HOT_BOARD_TEST B WHERE (A.CATEGORY_NUM, A.BOARD_NUM) = (B.CATEGORY_NUM, B.BOARD_NUM) ) AS A WHERE A.RN <= 9
